title: Four changes to avenCEO become intents
quote: Good: take all four changes to avenCEO.
means: The four changes AIP-2's reflection proposed each become an intent, measured before they are kept: a check is a script a machine runs (AIP-7), events stamped by a machine (AIP-8), a kind on every finding (AIP-9), and one spec round while you are reachable (AIP-10).

reflection.checked: every decision before D-52 that held
